lead_raw_text:
The structure of NaMg₆Zn crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a 32-atom unit cell containing Na₄Mg₂₄Zn₄ and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all four elements adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements, with Mg centers surrounded by varying Na, Mg, and Zn neighbors at 3.15–3.19 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Mg-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, while Mg–Na and Mg–Zn polyhedra share edges. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 32 sites.
